name: Pythilo
subtitle: Python IDE, course and labs
promotionalText: Real Python 3.14 on your iPhone and iPad. Code, debug and test offline, learn through 406 lessons, and explore your own algorithms in 96 interactive labs.
description:
Real Python, on your iPhone and iPad.

Pythilo combines a Python IDE, a course and interactive labs. CPython 3.14 runs on your device, so you can work on your projects without a cloud account or a connection.

A complete workspace
• Multi-file projects, folders, an editor built for touch, Python completion and problems as you type.
• Run with input(), clear tracebacks, a Stop button and a debugger with breakpoints, stepping and variables.
• A terminal with pipes and redirects, pytest, pip, Git, sqlite3 and npm.
• Real Git repositories: commits, branches, diffs, merge, rebase and HTTPS clone.
• Open and save ordinary .ipynb notebooks. Browse SQLite tables, edit rows and run SQL.

Web development on the device
• Django with SQLite and migrations, Flask, FastAPI and Starlette with Uvicorn.
• Start a server and open it in the built-in preview. Framework commands are one tap away.
• Install npm packages and build a React front end with esbuild on the device.

Packages and machine learning
• NumPy, PyTorch, Django, Flask, FastAPI, pytest, SymPy, NetworkX and more are bundled.
• Train real PyTorch networks on the CPU, offline. Run Core ML models from Python.
• pip installs pure-Python packages into each project. Compiled packages work when bundled.

Learn by writing code
• 406 lessons in 32 courses, from Python foundations to testing, architecture, async, the web, Pydantic, FastAPI, HTTPX, file formats, neural-network mathematics, PyTorch and language models.
• Exercises run your code and explain what came back and what was expected.
• Hints, runnable examples and 100 timed interview tasks. Advanced paths cover concurrency, transactions, statistical evaluation, ML operations, AI tool boundaries and 18 integration projects. New ML/AI systems projects train and select real models, audit nested and temporal validation, build permission-scoped BM25 retrieval, validate tool plans and evaluate release evidence.

See your algorithms work
• 96 labs across basics, data structures, algorithms, machine learning and AI.
• Trace your code, replay each step and see how it scales on growing inputs.
• Sorting, graphs, recursion, linked lists, trees, heaps, dynamic programming, gradient descent, neural networks, Adam, PCA, attention, causal masks, BPE, beam search and retrieval.

Work together
• Share projects through encrypted rooms with live edits and cursors. Run requests need permission from the device that executes them.
• Connect an AI client over your local network or through a room. Reading, editing and running have separate permissions.
• Free browser lessons and a Python playground at pythilo.com.

Made for iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape, with keyboard support on iPad. No account, analytics or ads.

Know the limits: no Node.js, Jupyter server, pandas, Matplotlib or SciPy. PyTorch uses the CPU; no MPS or torch.compile. iOS pauses servers when the app is in the background.
betaDescription: Pythilo is a Python IDE, course and set of interactive labs for iPhone and iPad. Python 3.14 runs on the device. Try projects, the terminal, debugger, notebooks, SQLite, Django and FastAPI, NumPy and PyTorch, 406 lessons, 100 interview tasks and 96 labs. Shared rooms connect the app to the playground at https://pythilo.com. The beta is free. Keep a copy of important projects and send feedback through TestFlight. No account is needed.
whatToTest: Build 24 adds 24 ML/AI Labs and linked lessons, including 12 larger projects. Train NumPy ridge and logistic models; audit nested group CV, walk-forward forecasts, OOF stacking and delayed-label rollout monitoring. Build permission-scoped BM25, versioned index updates with tombstones, a verified RAG-response pipeline, approved dependency-aware tool plans, a bounded scheduling simulation and a paired release-evaluation gate. New focused Labs cover weighted multiclass log loss, NDCG, clustered bootstrap, clipped IPS, temperature and isotonic calibration, MMR, chunked stop decoding, KV-cache reservation, strict schemas, evaluation coverage and citation provenance. The app now contains 96 Labs (45 ML, 28 AI), 406 path lessons in 32 courses and 100 interview tasks. 64 lesson/Lab pairs have links in both directions. Larger project traces follow orchestration; helper computations still execute and are checked. Saved provider outputs and serving simulations are explicitly identified: these fixtures do not run a real LLM or GPU server. Test all worked answers and rejection cases. Internal TestFlight only; no App Review or Beta App Review submission.
reviewNotes: This draft is prepared for a future release; no submission is requested. Pythilo embeds CPython 3.14 and runs the user's own code locally as an educational and development tool. No account or login is required. To try: Projects > New project > CSV Cleaner, open main.py and tap Run; use the Terminal to run pytest. Learn offers runnable lessons and Labs traces the user's algorithms. pip installs pure-Python packages from PyPI only when the user requests it; compiled libraries are bundled. npm fetches packages and esbuild builds them without Node.js. The built-in preview opens local web servers. The Local Network permission supports local servers and MCP connections initiated by the user. Shared rooms use https://pythilo.com, carry end-to-end encrypted project data, and require device-owner permission for remote run requests. There are no analytics or advertising SDKs.
